rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes human over-reliance and skill degradation when using automated SOC systems.
rationale.org-governance: Proposes organizational policies and training to govern the adoption of automation.
rationale.lit-review: Synthesizes secondary literature to construct a conceptual model of automation bias.
rationale.intro-framing: Defines the automation bias problem and proposes conceptual framework without operationalizing.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against automation-maximalism, advocating instead for preserving human-in-the-loop oversight.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Devotes focal analysis to the harm of human complacency and over-reliance.
rationale.risk-security: Analyzes real-world security breaches caused by automation complacency in SOCs.
